description: Candidate-neutral fixture-intent state for RQ-C1 architecture-reverser scenarios. Fixture intent only: candidate engines construct legal native state/progression from this description. No candidate-native IDs permitted in any field.

attack_mode.description: Multiplayer attack permission model where relevant (CR 802/803 neutral labels).

continuous_effects_present.description: Neutral labels of continuous effects relevant to the scenario (e.g. HUMILITY, PROPAGANDA_P0). No engine internals.

decision_script.description: Ordered scripted future external decisions (intent key + decision kind + actor + chosen semantic option).

hands.description: Per-player hand content. Hidden hands give count only; known identities listed only where the scenario legitimately grants knowledge.

known_private_information.description: Explicit map of which principal knows which private fact at scenario start.

libraries.description: Per-player library: count + optional known top/bottom cards where legitimately known.

phase.description: Neutral phase/step label at scenario start. Must be a native-safe boundary (never inside a decision-bearing step unless the decision is part of the script).

rng_starting_contract.description: RNG starting contract ref (RNG operation ID in RQ_C1_RNG_EXPECTATIONS.json) or null.

stack.description: Stack objects only where the scenario legitimately begins with a stack (native-cast sequencing preferred).

commander_damage_taken.description: Map commander-id -> damage taken (pre-game seeded only where scenario redesign permits).

chosen_option.description: Semantic identity of the chosen option (card name, mode label, target description, number, yes/no). Never a candidate-native ID.
